name: CoA quest super-track patch: Poisoning the World's diamond points at each trainer (#8058)
contract: The client resolves a tracked quest's diamond from QuestSuperTrack.dbc (quest -> SuperTrack nodes) and SuperTrack.dbc (node -> position). The start-zone class quest 200025 has no QuestSuperTrack row, so the client fell back to the height-less quest_poi area.

The login patch stream sends coa_client_quest_super_track rows as SMSG_PATCH_QUEST_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BF): ID, QuestID, then 20 SuperTrack ids for each of the 4 objectives (fields 2, 22, 42, 62) and 20 for completion (field 82). The opcode is the Extensions.dll handler-name table entry after SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BE).

Row 33201 binds objective 0 to node 21083 at Exodite Telusaara's spawn on Aldrassil's upper floor (10458.2, 807.65, 1346.75), objective 1 to 21084 (Darkslayer Harrendor), objective 2 to 21085 (Baarelam) and completion to 21086 (Ko'rahl Fangshifter). The nodes are unused ids inside the client's SuperTrack range: in game, a node id above its max (21632) was not found and the diamond fell back to the quest_poi area. Socketless packet construction does not establish how the client renders the diamond.

steps.label: The login stream sends QuestSuperTrack row 33201 once
